nodes.label: AshaSathi iOS App Icon (1024x1024)
nodes.description: App icon for AshaSathi. Light mint/white gradient background. Bold green text reads 'ASHA' on the top line and 'SATHI' on the bottom line, both in a sans-serif font. The letter 'H' in 'ASHA' is stylized as a house/home icon with a triangular roof and a window, reinforcing a home or shelter theme. The overall color palette is green on a pale green-white background.
